title: X11: Call `rect_changed_callback` in `window_set_size` so viewport updates

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #105597

## Additional information

Initially, the versions specified there were: v4.6.dev1.official [8d8041bd4], v4.5.stable.official [876b29033], v4.5.dev2.official [af2c713].

But I fixed this on master 4.8.dev5+. Essentially, this should also be included in the specified versions.

---

Minimal project for testing: [windowTest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32162819/windowTest.zip)

It looks like this:
```gdscript
extends Node2D

# helper
func center(newSize: Vector2i) -> void:
	DisplayServer.window_set_position(
		(DisplayServer.screen_get_size(DisplayServer.window_get_current_screen()) - newSize) / 2.0
	)

func _ready() -> void:
	var newSize: Vector2i = Vector2i(1366, 768)
	center(newSize)
	
	# wait
	await get_tree().create_timer(2.0).timeout
	
	# set
	DisplayServer.window_set_size(newSize)
	#get_window().size = newSize # fix
	center(newSize)
```

Helper here is for convenience of visibility, so that the window is always centered.

It also waits 2 seconds before changing the window resolution.

**How it was:**

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6add9298-d6ba-4143-9866-dc694dd6e972

Additionally: Here it can be seen that after I moved the window, the `viewport` was updated automatically.

**How it is now:**

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/85093063-936a-4752-ac12-2330bf8c4645

---

**What changed:**

Basically, in the code I additionally specified `get_window().size = newSize`, which was mentioned by @shdon in #105597. Such a window resize actually fixes the problem.

I associated this with the fact that it triggers an update or an event. Therefore, I found how it does this and added the update that was missing in `window_set_size`. And now it works as it should have.
